summary: This study looks at cholesterol self-testing for adults who have had an acute coronary syndrome, which is a sudden blockage of blood flow to the heart. Participants will test their own cholesterol levels to see if it helps lower their LDL cholesterol, a type of fat in the blood that can clog arteries. The University of Leipzig is running this trial with a target of 200 participants. The status of the study is currently unknown status.
